rules: When Product Prototyper classifies the outcome as Baseline Needed because an existing frontend has no applicable accepted baseline, has a named current-experience gap, or has an explicitly requested source refresh, send the fixed mode-specific bootstrap message defined in the Product Prototyper skill. It must identify the selected source frontend and the separate prototype repository/root and must not include future-state requirements or the Product ticket package.

When Prototype Bootstrapper classifies a current-experience bootstrap, correction, or refresh as Completed or Blocked, return the runnable baseline or precise blocker, bootstrap report, source pin, separate prototype repository/root, and exact comparison evidence to Product Prototyper for acceptance or recovery. Bootstrapper does not finalize the ticket or create Product Prototyper's accepted commit.
